hardware.status: Planned 8S configuration selected by user; fitted hardware pending confirmation

parts.name: FMS 90 mm / 12 blade / 4075 KV1500
parts.basis: Manufacturer confirms candidate identity. Installed SKU pending; 48 N thrust is the project planning estimate, not a measured curve.

parts.name: Hobbywing FLYFUN 120A V5
parts.basis: Planned candidate. Simulation uses a conservative 120 A ceiling, not a reproduction of ESC firmware or thermal protection.

parts.name: 4 × TowerPro MG996R
parts.spec: 55 g each • 1.079 N m stall • 0.15 s/60° at 6 V
parts.basis: User-selected in planning BOM; manufacturer specification. ±15° linkage travel is from current simulation. Lag, deadband angle and loaded response require measurement.

parts.name: 8S LiPo — pack SKU pending
parts.spec: 29.6 V nominal / 33.6 V full • default 5 Ah / 45C
parts.basis: Capacity and C-rating are editable scenario assumptions, consistent with FMS's 8S power-system application recommendation. Resistance, RC and thermal coefficients are estimates. Mass stays at the existing assembly mass when capacity changes.

parts.name: Project EDF Drone v2 CAD
parts.basis: Master Parts List.xlsx contains these structural entries only. Rendered geometry is decimated directly from drone_v2_physics.usd; fin collision geometry is simplified.

parts.name: Existing Isaac assembly
parts.spec: 3.104 kg total; body inertia 0.05 / 0.05 / 0.02 kg m²
parts.basis: Values read from current configuration/USD, not a new hardware weighing or inertia measurement. Component masses are already lumped into the assembly; no battery mass is added twice.

parts.name: Pixhawk 6C / Mauch HS-200-HV planned
parts.basis: No hardware-in-loop connection. Gyro truth is shown separately from the controller observation. Auxiliary electrical draw is a lumped 10 W estimate; BEC/servo stall-current dynamics are not modeled.

convex_parameters.label: Corridor enforcement
convex_parameters.help: Strict rejects plans outside the corridor and holds if infeasible. Soft penalizes excess and permits emergency fallback. Neither guarantees actual vehicle tracking.

convex_parameters.label: Parallel solver workers
convex_parameters.help: Independent time candidates solved concurrently. Physics and controller intervals are unchanged; CPU contention may affect solver time limits.

convex_parameters.label: Cost
convex_parameters.help: energy: electrical Wh with the momentum-theory power law; delta_v: integral of |T|/m. The weights below add secondary costs, each priced in seconds of hover cost.

convex_parameters.label: Path following
convex_parameters.help: Price of planned cross-track distance from the drawn route, even inside the corridor. 0 lets the plan ride the corridor edge.

convex_parameters.label: Time
convex_parameters.help: Price of plan duration; also tries shorter waypoint-leg timings. Energy already pays hover power per second.

convex_parameters.label: Smoothness
convex_parameters.unit: s hover / s at slew bound
convex_parameters.help: Quadratic price of thrust jerk. Smoother plans leave vane authority for feedback.

convex_parameters.label: Tilt margin
convex_parameters.unit: s hover / s at max tilt
convex_parameters.help: Quadratic price of planned tilt: keeps attitude margin for gust rejection.

convex_parameters.label: Max speed
convex_parameters.help: Speed cone on every plan node (paper eq. 10). Waypoint speeds may not exceed it.

convex_parameters.label: Max planned tilt
convex_parameters.help: Thrust-pointing cone. Must stay below the tracking tilt limit.

convex_parameters.label: Glide slope
convex_parameters.help: Approach cone half-angle from vertical on the landing leg (paper eq. 11).

convex_parameters.label: Cone narrowing time
convex_parameters.help: A widened cone is back to nominal this long before the landing gate.

convex_parameters.label: Route floor
convex_parameters.help: Minimum body altitude on waypoint legs.

convex_parameters.label: Min thrust
convex_parameters.help: rho1 floor: vanes lose authority without jet flow.

convex_parameters.label: Tracking reserve
convex_parameters.help: Share of the thrust above weight withheld from the plan for feedback.

convex_parameters.label: Descent/brake ratio
convex_parameters.help: Planned downward acceleration never exceeds this times the braking acceleration.

convex_parameters.label: Duty rate
convex_parameters.help: Upper bound of the duty slew (the rotor reaction yaws the body).

convex_parameters.label: Duty-rate yaw share
convex_parameters.help: Duty slew also capped so its rotor reaction uses this share of the yaw authority.

convex_parameters.label: Tilt-rate share
convex_parameters.help: Planned attitude slew as a share of what full vane deflection sustains.

convex_parameters.label: Default half-width
convex_parameters.help: Corridor around the drawn route for steps without their own width.

convex_parameters.label: Excess penalty
convex_parameters.help: Price of flying outside the corridor (soft constraint). Higher follows the corridor harder.

convex_parameters.label: Fly-through aim
convex_parameters.help: Plan fly-throughs inside this share of their capture radius.

convex_parameters.label: Fly-through min speed
convex_parameters.help: Slowest along-route speed at a gate. 1 with 0 deg crosses every gate at exactly the leg speed.

convex_parameters.label: Fly-through heading tolerance
convex_parameters.help: Largest angle between the gate velocity and the route tangent. Lets tight turns cut in.

convex_parameters.label: Landing nodes
convex_parameters.help: Intervals on the powered-descent leg.

convex_parameters.label: Route interval
convex_parameters.help: Target node spacing on waypoint legs.

convex_parameters.label: Max nodes per leg
convex_parameters.help: Longer legs get wider node spacing.

convex_parameters.label: Solver time limit
convex_parameters.help: Clarabel time limit per SOCP.

convex_parameters.label: Re-plan period
convex_parameters.help: Closed-loop re-solve interval.

convex_parameters.label: Re-plan position error
convex_parameters.help: Beyond this tracking error the plan restarts from the measured state.

convex_parameters.label: Re-plan velocity error
convex_parameters.help: Beyond this velocity error the plan restarts from the measured state.

convex_parameters.label: Freeze before gate
convex_parameters.help: No re-solve this close to the landing gate.

convex_parameters.label: Feedforward blend
convex_parameters.help: Cross-fade of the thrust feedforward after a re-plan.

convex_parameters.label: Planning latency
convex_parameters.help: Flight-computer model: a re-plan takes over this long after it was requested (asynchronous solve). 0 = instant.

convex_parameters.label: Gate height
convex_parameters.help: Powered descent ends this far above touchdown height.

convex_parameters.label: Terminal max descent
convex_parameters.help: Rate clamp of the vertical terminal descent (a Landing step sets it from its touchdown speed).

convex_parameters.label: Centering radius
convex_parameters.help: Full descent rate only while this well centered over the pad.

convex_parameters.label: Gate capture radius
convex_parameters.help: Hand over to terminal descent when this close to the gate.

convex_parameters.label: Sink-rate envelope
convex_parameters.help: The landing leg never sinks faster than it could brake to the gate with this share of its braking margin. Lower is gentler; 0 disables.

convex_parameters.label: Braking emergency
convex_parameters.help: Switch to the fast (spool-up) duty slew when a stop at the yaw-safe slew needs more than this share of the height above touchdown. 0 disables.

convex_parameters.label: kp horizontal
convex_parameters.help: Position feedback.

convex_parameters.label: kd horizontal
convex_parameters.help: Velocity feedback.

convex_parameters.label: ki horizontal
convex_parameters.help: Integral (wind, CoM trim).

convex_parameters.label: kp vertical
convex_parameters.help: Position feedback.

convex_parameters.label: kd vertical
convex_parameters.help: Velocity feedback.

convex_parameters.label: ki vertical
convex_parameters.help: Integral (thrust bias).

convex_parameters.label: Max correction
convex_parameters.help: Feedback acceleration bound per axis group.

convex_parameters.label: Max commanded tilt
convex_parameters.help: Tilt command limit; plans stay under the planned tilt.
